translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

content: Anutufa Abaraqaammanara aneenna amaaku Isakeena tatufirana suqa qimiannee qu ufafa.
Mariiufanoo Anutufa Abaraqaammana amanammasee qafaanee qimasee innaarunaindari aaramasee qinau. Oo Abaraqaama qufanoo Abaraqaammafa qinau qinee maaqoo maridaqa. Miqi qufanoo Anutufa qimaminau.

Aneenna amaaku Isakeena ani amaaku moodaa, kaaqa amuqusa imariannana afiqeenana Mooria maqa maaqai ooru rainaqa qinee aaqana moo uqafiqaanaura. Anee mi aaqannanasaa aneenna amaaku arusee qini tatufirana suqa qimia.
Miqi qimasoofanoo kananaana findifinoo narí dookisaa ida rufariseenoo minasaa quqaseenoo narí ainaini maru faiqi qanda faqa narí amaaku Isakeena faqa nifiqeenoo findimeeqee Anutufa qimamunnai finau.
Qaara afuru aanai fi faiqaqau. Qaaramoo kufanoo Anutufa qimaqoo aaqannafa nianasaa marufanoo qafanau.

Qafamaseenoo Abaraqammafa narí ainaini maru faiqi qanda qimanniminoo qinau. Inneeqara maaqoo marida doonkisaa rakisiaqa. Qeeqa qimaakundiri miqoo ooru Anutunara innaaru qimasee inneeqara iannai qumuanaura.

Miqi qimaseenoo Abaraqaammafa tatufirana suqaaninna idana mareeqeenoo Isakeenasaa soofanoo maroofanoo narí ida qeemaruna akuru mandeenoo mina qumareenoo musuka faqa qumareenoo doo narí faiqi afiqeenoo Anutufa qimaqoo aaqanna kaaqa ooru finau.

Aanai ooru fimarufanoo Isakeefa narí akoona aaramaseenoo qinau, Qipoo qufanoo Abaraqaammafa maqi qimasee qinau. Nanaree qidanee qufanoo Isakeefa qinau. Qinee qafaunana anee idati faqa ida rumbarana faqa maree fimarinanoo, yaafee tatufirana suqeefandinna sipsipafa maridanoo fee.
Abaraqaammafa maaqi qimasee narí amaaku qimaminau. Anutufa narí kai sipsipa aanaaqi moodaa qiminaqa tatufirana suqamianaura. Miqi qimaseeqa miqanda moodaanaki ooru fiqau.
Miqanda Anutufa qimaqoo aaqannasaa ooru reeqa Abaraqaammafa ooniuqa mareeqee aaku aakummaseenoo ida mina amuaaqa quqaseenoo narí faiqi Isakeena ruumbeeqeenoo rafusu idasaa rusinau.
Rusiseenoo musuka qumareenoo narí faiqi kuqa arusaaneera inau.
Karaambaiqa angiroo innaarunaindari aaramaseenoo qinau, Abaraqaamma, Abaraqaamma, miqi qufanoo Abaraqaammafa qinau. Qinee maa maridaqee qufanoo Karaambaiqa qinau.

Sia faiqi arua, sia mandaikamma amaqaa. Sia aneenna asaukukoo aneenna faiqi arua. Doo maqee qinee iridaqa anee Anutuna ufa qaindusidana mina ufa afaqee mariananoo. Anee aneenna amaakuara aneenna amuqusa uqannara sia qaoo qiananoo eedoo kai qiananoo.

Miqi qufanoo Abaraqaammafa uqeerafinoo qafoofanoo andandaki sipsipa akoona saqari aanaaqiki aanai rutaqusee marufanoo qafanau. Qafamaseenoo Abaraqaammafa narí amaaku amaaqa maqeenoo sipsipa akoona aruseenoo Anutuna tatufirana suqa aminau.
Miqooqari Abaraqaammafa mi aaqanna auqu reenoo, Karaambaiqa nimira aaqanee qinau. Minara maqee mindaraasa maaqi qidaqa, Yaaweefa narí aaqanasaa nimidanoo fee qidaqa.
Karaambaiqa angiroo innaarunaindari kaifaa Abaraqaammana aaramaseenoo qinau.
Karaambaiqa aniara maqi qidanoo. Qinee qeeqa duqusaa qima afeekaikammasee qidaqa. Qinee firaaqoo ani amiqimma amaqaanaura. Anee aneenna amaaku moodaa sia qaoo qiannanara qinee miqianaura.

Qinee kuqaa qima afeekaikammasee anisaa ani aruakinausa ani aiku asauku innaarunai fasaura foora moomoo marifaranoo nukudara foora ani amianauranoo. Ani aiku asauku namuqaa rafaaqa fusee misa ainaina maree marifaranoo.
Aiqama maqannaasa qiniara ani aiku asauku amiqi amiqimma nimaaqaafanandee masee maasa faqa amiqi amiqimma qimaqaannee qifaranoo. Anee qini aakapara ufa qaindusuannanara miqiqa.
Abaraqaammafa miqooqari narí faiqi Isakeesandiri narí ainainira faiqi qara qumi nifiqee narí maru maqusanai Beeraseeba maqusai ooqu marinau.
Naqoorana aiku asauku nuqu.
Mariiufanoo Abaraqaammafa irufanoo Mirikaa nammarifa Naqoorana Abaraqaammana akaqa faiqi qisauku dinni taikasee dinni oonu qaarammoo marasee 8 maqee foo qiqau.
Usafa indaaruqaafa Busafa mina aanaaqiannaafa marinau, mina aanaaqiannaafa Keemueerafa mifa Arammana akoofa marinau.

Mina aanaaqiannaafa Keeseedafa marinau, mina aanaaqiannaafa Qasoorafa marinau, mina aanaaqiannaafa Piradasafa marinau mina aanaaqiannaafa Didarafa marinau, misa ninaaqiannaafa Beetueerafa marinau. Mifa Reebeeka nammarina akoofa marinau. Mirikaa nammarifa mi faiqi namusa Naqoorana Abaraqaammana akaqasaa maqanau.
Reumma nammarifa Naqoorana inaaqiannaa anaasee fannoo Teebana faqa Kaqammana faqa Taqasana faqa Maakaana faqa maqanau.
